gaps.issue: The ticket requires a migration: sensitive zone, a written and approved plan is needed before the code.
Criteria 1 and 2 ask for REAL and float for a rate that goes into an amount; AGENTS.md forbids an amount to go through a float.
"Performance stays good" gives neither a measure nor a threshold.
"One vat key per invoice" while the rate is per line: which value? And the API format does not change without docs/api.md.

criteria.text: The rate is stored as decimal text and read as a Decimal, never as a float.
docs/api.md describes the new key in the same PR as the format change.

split: The migration and its rollback, with an approved plan.
The per-line computation in billing/totals.py, once the column is in place.
The vat key in the API and docs/api.md.

questions.question: What is the vat key of an invoice whose lines have different rates?
questions.default: No key per invoice: one rate per line in the detail.
